verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party seller-facing statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeping exports for connected accounts. What it does show is adjacent and earns no credit: an embedded onboarding component, platform-side payout management, and a balance-retrieval API, which is a developer building block rather than a self-serve reporting experience.

support.subject: As an ops user, sellers can self-serve their money questions — per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, and exports that let their bookkeeper close the month without contacting me

citations.quote: To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
Manage payouts and external accounts for your connected accounts.
